# Clustered light fixtures

`TypeB-AsymmetricNarrow.ies`: a real type B photometric file, a laboratory report of a floodlight with an asymmetric narrow
beam, published as `Type B - 03.ies` in an MIT repository, read 2026-11-06 and unchanged. Its source and credit are in this
folder's row of `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.
